title: Finite-Query Coherent Projection of Black-Box Conditional Predictions
summary: Local conditional predictions from a black box need not admit a common joint distribution. We study two aspects of their coherent projection: finite-access precision and directional fidelity. For arbitrary deterministic binary conditional tables, we establish matching expected minimax excess conditional-Kullback--Leibler risk $Θ(\min\{R\sqrt{d/B},d^2/B\})$ under independent uniform exact-table queries, with repeated draws charged, for a local bounded pairwise joint class. The result holds for sufficiently large $d$, $R\sqrt d\le M_0$, and $Cd^3\le B\le(d2^{d-1})^{1/3}$, where $M_0$ is fixed.…
